description: Today, Michael Whatley, local sheriffs, and local elected leaders hosted a press conference to discuss why law enforcement organizations are backing Whatley’s campaign. Topics included Governor Cooper’s tragic decision to prematurely release violent offenders and how most of these criminals ended up back in jail.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Whatley for Senate
title: Michael Whatley and Law Enforcement Officials Call Out Roy Cooper’s Soft on Crime Record in Craven County – Michael Whatley for Senate
